overloadPatches.semanticRole: Searches all records of the table containing targetField for those whose value matches at least one element of array, replacing the current selection with the matches.

constraints: Cannot be used with fields of the Picture or BLOB type.
targetField and array must be of the same data type, except that a Longint array may be compared against a field of the Time type.
Scope differs from QUERY SELECTION WITH ARRAY, which restricts the search to the current selection instead of the whole table.
